items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the equivalence of three formulations of the condition (RS): the original one, the requirement that the comparison functor from the category over a fibre product to the 2-fibre product of the categories over the factors be an equivalence for surjective maps, and the same requirement for small extensions (statement lines 5093-5106). The proof (proof lines 5108-5150) derives the 2-categorical form from the object and morphism descriptions, notes the trivial implication, and recovers the fibre product description in the small extension case by an explicit computation of morphism sets. H2: two directions with an explicit morphism set computation, written out in full.
